en.p: The sequence $\{a_n\}$ satisfies $a_2=-a_1$ and, for every natural number $n\ge 2$,

en.eq: a_{n+1}=\begin{cases} a_n-\sqrt{n}\times a_{\sqrt{n}} & (\text{if } \sqrt{n} \text{ is a natural number and } a_n>0) \\ a_n+1 & (\text{otherwise}) \end{cases}

en.p: Find the product of all values of $a_1$ for which $a_{15}=1$. [4 points]
